lines.trans: Look at our small wooden sign for the street gate—short, warm, and easy to read.
Read it aloud for me, Qing, so I hear how a neighbour hears it.
Room Nine Garden Café — Fresh Soup, Warm Bread, Lemon Tart & Tea — Open Daily.
And underneath in smaller letters: Friday Piano Tea at Six O'Clock.
My aunt's exact Friday hour right on the gate! That makes me proud.
I also wrote the four prices clearly in big numbers so nobody has to squint.
Even without glasses I can read those numbers from two metres away!
Did you leave a small basket by the door for neighbourhood book sharing?
Right beside the piano—all those clean travel books from the hallway bookcase!
A public café, a neighbourhood reading corner, and live music—every word of the city rule!
Let me go practice the waltz once through while Mei bakes the tart shells.

lines.trans: I will carry these menu cards into the kitchen and check on Mei!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

一字不差.gloss: word for word; to the letter

meanings.en: word for word; to the letter
meanings.note: Pinyin: yí zì bù chà. Four-character idiom 一字 ('one character/word') + 不差 ('not off at all'); yī shifts to yí before 4th-tone zì.

examples.text: 我们对公众开放的咖啡角和读书角，跟市政厅的规定一字不差！
examples.trans: Our public café corner and reading nook match City Hall's requirements word for word!

examples.text: 小晴把姑姑留下的菜谱一字不差地抄在了新卡片上。
examples.trans: Qing copied the recipe left by the aunt onto a new card word for word.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最下面 ('the bottom part').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 你也不用太悲观了，可以试试云海卫视。
examples.trans: You do not need to be too pessimistic either; you can try Yunhai Television.

examples.text: 这是不用。
examples.trans: This is 不用.

meanings.note: Formal preposition/conjunction yǔ ('with; and').

examples.text: 他不宜与艺人见面。
examples.trans: He should not meet with artists.

examples.text: 这事与你无关。
examples.trans: This matter has nothing to do with you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本书 ('a book').

examples.text: 书桌上放着两本安静的旧书。
examples.trans: Two old books sit on the desk.

examples.text: 她喜欢坐在院子里看书。
examples.trans: She likes sitting in the courtyard reading a book.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū jià. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个书架 ('a bookcase').

examples.text: 看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
examples.trans: Look at this arrow—it points at the bookcase in the hallway!

examples.text: 那个大书架靠着那面墙，已经二十年了！
examples.trans: That big bookcase has stood against that wall for twenty years!

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

从头到尾.gloss: from start to finish; all the way through

meanings.en: from start to finish; all the way through
meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng tóu dào wěi. Four-character phrase 从头 ('from the head/beginning') + 到尾 ('to the tail/end').

examples.text: 趁小美在厨房烤挞皮，宋老师把圆舞曲从头到尾练了一遍。
examples.trans: While Mei was baking tart shells in the kitchen, Teacher Song practised the waltz all the way through once.

examples.text: 老陈把九号房的四扇拱窗从头到尾仔细检查了一遍。
examples.trans: Chen carefully inspected all four arched windows of Room Nine from start to finish.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jià qian. Everyday spoken word for price (note neutral-tone qian); more conversational than 价格.

examples.text: 这种本地蜂蜜味道好，价钱也公道。
examples.trans: This local honey tastes great, and the price is fair too.

examples.text: 买之前先问清楚每公斤的价钱。
examples.trans: Ask clearly about the price per kilo before buying.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàng wǎn. Combines 傍 ('draw near to') + 晚 ('evening'): the golden hour around sunset.

examples.text: 傍晚的时候，院子里的灯笼一盏接一盏亮了。
examples.trans: At dusk, the lanterns in the courtyard lit up one after another.

examples.text: 夏天的傍晚最适合坐在院子里乘凉。
examples.trans: Summer evenings at dusk are perfect for sitting in the courtyard to enjoy the breeze.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quán. Emphasizes entirety before 都 or a verb (全都 'every single one').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōng zhòng. Measure word (量词): 群, e.g. 一群公众 ('members of the public').

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 小院花园每天上午向公众开放。
examples.trans: The courtyard garden opens to the public every morning.

related.gloss: members of the public (measure word 群)

meanings.note: Pinyin: liù. Cardinal number 6.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

examples.text: 共享信息不方便。
examples.trans: Sharing data on my personal machine is inconvenient.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

原封不动.gloss: untouched; kept intact without a single change

meanings.en: untouched; kept intact without a single change
meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán fēng bú dòng. Four-character idiom 原封 ('original seal') + 不动 ('unmoved/untouched'); bù shifts to 2nd-tone bú before 4th-tone dòng.

examples.text: 姑姑当年的星期五钢琴茶叙时间，原封不动地写在了新木牌上！
examples.trans: My aunt's original Friday piano-tea hour is written right on the new wooden sign without a single change!

examples.text: 抽屉里那叠三十年前的旧乐谱一直原封不动地保存着。
examples.trans: That stack of thirty-year-old sheet music in the drawer has been preserved completely intact.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chú fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间厨房 ('a kitchen').

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.en: have a listen; listen a bit
meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng ting. Reduplicated verb making an invitation to listen warm and unhurried.

examples.text: 听听他说的！老陈比我们好奇两倍！
examples.trans: Listen to him! Chen is twice as curious as we are!

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi jiǎo. Combines 咖啡 ('coffee/café') + 角 ('corner/nook'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 木牌上写着：九号房花园咖啡角——鲜汤、热面包、柠檬挞与清茶。
examples.trans: On the wooden sign it reads: Room Nine Garden Café Corner—Fresh Soup, Warm Bread, Lemon Tart & Tea.

examples.text: 阳光洒进一楼的咖啡角，四张木桌看起来格外温暖。
examples.trans: Sunlight pours into the ground-floor café corner, making the four wooden tables look extra warm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sì. Cardinal number 4.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tú shū. Collective noun 图 ('charts/illustrations') + 书 ('books'), used for shared reading collections (共享图书 'shared books').

examples.text: 小晴在九号房门边放了一个街坊共享图书的小竹篮。
examples.trans: Qing placed a small bamboo basket by the door of Room Nine for neighbourhood book sharing.

examples.text: 街坊们喝茶的时候，都喜欢从竹篮里挑一本喜欢的图书来看。
examples.trans: While drinking tea, neighbours love picking a book they like from the bamboo basket to read.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán wǔ qǔ. Compound from 圆 ('circle') + 舞 ('dance') + 曲 ('musical piece'). Measure word: 首 (shǒu).

examples.text: 宋老师在钢琴上弹了一首轻快的圆舞曲。
examples.trans: Teacher Song played a lively waltz on the piano.

examples.text: 这首老圆舞曲让人想起三十年前的晚茶会。
examples.trans: This old waltz brings back memories of evening tea gatherings thirty years ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个外面 ('an outside area').

examples.text: 等等——现在十米外的院子里坐着谁？
examples.trans: Wait—who is sitting ten metres away in our courtyard right now?

examples.text: 门外站着一位拿箱子的客人。
examples.trans: A guest holding a suitcase is standing outside the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà shēng. Combines 大 ('big/loud') + 声 ('voice/sound'); modifies verbs of speaking or reading directly (大声念 'read aloud').

examples.text: 小晴，把木牌上的字大声念给我听听吧。
examples.trans: Qing, read the words on the wooden sign aloud for me to hear.

examples.text: 周经理在院子里大声宣布九号房咖啡角正式通过了审核。
examples.trans: In the courtyard, Manager Zhou announced aloud that the Room Nine café corner had officially passed the review.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū gu. Specifically father's sister (second syllable neutral tone); distinct from 阿姨 / 姨妈 (mother's sister).

examples.text: 周经理的姑姑以前也住在这座老院子里。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou's paternal aunt used to live in this old courtyard too.

examples.text: 我姑姑年轻的时候最喜欢弹钢琴。
examples.trans: When my aunt was young, she loved playing the piano most of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个字 ('a written character').

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: róng yì. Stative adjective ('easy to do'); before a verb, 很容易 / 不容易 means 'easily / not prone to'.

examples.text: 厚陶瓷杯很结实，不容易摔破。
examples.trans: Thick ceramic cups are sturdy and don't break easily.

examples.text: 有老陈带路，找五金摊就容易多了。
examples.trans: With Chen leading the way, finding the hardware stall is much easier.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì. Means 'correct!' on its own, 'right' as a result complement (拿对), or 'to/toward' before a noun.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù suàn. Pairs with 也 in the next clause: 就算…也… ('even if…, still…').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 留下来，小美。就算他转身走出大门，我也认了。
examples.trans: I am staying, Mei. Even if he turns around and walks straight out the gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì zhèng tīng. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座市政厅 ('a city hall').

examples.text: 等等，志鹏——你还在市政厅合同科工作？！
examples.trans: Wait, Zhipeng—you still work at City Hall's contract office?!

examples.text: 下周我保证把半个市政厅的同事都带来小美这儿喝咖啡。
examples.trans: Next week I promise to bring half my City Hall colleagues to Mei's tables.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān jìng. Note first tone gān ('dry/clean'), never fourth tone.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi fàng. Describes opening a courtyard, garden, or café to visitors.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 比现在翻一倍！我们真的要对整条街开放小院咖啡馆吗？
examples.trans: Double what I bake now! Are we really opening the courtyard café to our whole street?

meanings.note: Time noun dāngnián ('in bygone years, back then').

examples.text: 当年他离开卫视时得罪了不少人。
examples.trans: Back when he left the network, he offended many people.

examples.text: 她想起当年刚进大学时的梦想。
examples.trans: She recalled her dreams from her freshman days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn. Used for reading a letter or notice out loud (念第一行 'read the first line aloud').

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

examples.text: 实习感觉怎么样？
examples.trans: How does the internship feel?

examples.text: 这是感觉。
examples.trans: This is 感觉.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài. Specifically for accessories placed on the head, face, neck, or wrist—contrast 穿 for clothes/shoes.

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ná. Core verb for holding or fetching objects in the hand.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà. Used for hanging keys, coats, lanterns, or hanging up a phone.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tà pí. Combines 挞 ('tart') + 皮 ('crust/shell/skin'); synonymous with 挞底; measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 趁小美在厨房烤杏仁挞皮，宋老师去阳光房练了一遍钢琴。
examples.trans: While Mei was baking almond tart shells in the kitchen, Teacher Song went to the sunroom to practise the piano.

examples.text: 烤好的挞皮放凉以后，再填入温热浓稠的柠檬凝乳。
examples.trans: Once the baked tart shells have cooled, fill them with warm, thick lemon curd.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个数字 ('a number / digit').

examples.text: 全是灰色小数字！我看到第一页心就停了！
examples.trans: Nothing but tiny grey numbers! My heart stopped at page one!

examples.text: 把上面铜牌的灰尘擦掉……等等，快念那个数字！
examples.trans: Brush the dust off the brass plate on top... wait, read that number!

meanings.note: Pinyin: páng biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 旁边位置 ('a spot beside').

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǚ xíng. Measure word (量词): 次 (cì), e.g. 一次旅行 ('a trip').

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

examples.text: 坐早班火车去成都是一次难忘的旅行。
examples.trans: Taking the morning train to Chengdu was an unforgettable trip.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí jiān. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段时间 ('a period of time').

examples.text: 新买家来看房子之前，只给我们三十天时间！
examples.trans: Before new buyers inspect the building, they give us only thirty days!

examples.text: 离火车开还有半个小时的时间。
examples.trans: There is still half an hour before the train departs.

related.gloss: a period of time (measure word 段)

meanings.note: Friendly workplace farewell míngtiān jiàn.

examples.text: 我先走了，明天见！
examples.trans: I am heading off, see you tomorrow!

examples.text: 大家辛苦了，明天见！
examples.trans: Great work everyone, see you tomorrow!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 每个星期五 ('every Friday').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù pái. Combines 木 ('wooden') + 牌 ('signboard/plaque'); measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 看看我们准备挂在街门上的小木牌——简短、温暖，又容易读。
examples.trans: Look at the small wooden sign we are hanging on the street gate—short, warm, and easy to read.

examples.text: 小晴用端正的黑字在木牌上写下了咖啡角的营业时间。
examples.trans: Qing wrote the café corner's opening hours on the wooden sign in neat black lettering.

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng méng tà. Combines 柠檬 ('lemon') + 挞 ('tart', phonetic loan from English 'tart').

examples.text: 星期二我们要修好琴键，还要烤星期三的柠檬挞！
examples.trans: On Tuesday we will fix the piano key and bake Wednesday's lemon tarts!

examples.text: 酸甜清香的杏仁柠檬挞成了咖啡角的招牌甜点。
examples.trans: Sweet-tart, fragrant almond lemon tart became the café corner's signature dessert.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi rì. Concise written equivalent of 每天 ('every day'), common on shop signs and menus (每日营业 'Open Daily').

examples.text: 木牌最后写着四个大字：每日营业，欢迎街坊常来坐坐。
examples.trans: At the bottom of the wooden sign are four bold characters: Open Daily—neighbours are always welcome.

examples.text: 小美的厨房每日都会准备新鲜熬制的蔬菜高汤。
examples.trans: Mei's kitchen prepares freshly simmered vegetable stock daily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tāng. Measure word (量词): 碗 (wǎn), e.g. 一碗汤 ('a bowl of soup').

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

related.gloss: a bowl of soup (measure word 碗)

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng qīng chǔ chǔ. AABB reduplication of 清楚 ('clear/distinct'); often used after 看得 or 听得 ('see/hear clearly').

examples.text: 老陈，你在笑呢！我在灯光底下看得清清楚楚！
examples.trans: You are smiling, Chen! I saw it crystal clear under the lamplight!

examples.text: 院子里的每一个人都把小提琴和钢琴的合奏听得清清楚楚。
examples.trans: Everyone in the courtyard heard the violin and piano duet crystal clear.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng chá. Combines 清 ('clear/pure/unadulterated') + 茶 ('tea'): freshly brewed green or herbal tea served without heavy additions; measure word: 杯 (bēi) or 壶 (hú).

examples.text: 欢迎木牌上写着：鲜汤、热面包、柠檬挞与清茶——每日营业。
examples.trans: On the welcome sign it reads: Fresh Soup, Warm Bread, Lemon Tart & Fragrant Tea—Open Daily.

examples.text: 午后坐在阳光房里喝一杯清茶、读几页书，真是舒服极了。
examples.trans: Sitting in the sunroom in the afternoon with a cup of pure tea and a few pages of a book is pure bliss.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn nuǎn. Warmer and more emotional than plain 暖; used for sunshine, sound, and kindness.

examples.text: 听……有点低，很温暖，等等——中间这个琴键没有声音！
examples.trans: Listen... a little low, very warm, and wait—this middle key makes no sound!

examples.text: 谢谢你，你的话让我很温暖。
examples.trans: Thank you, your words make me feel warm inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎo. Used for baking bread, rolls, and cakes in an oven.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 多烤几块边角，好姑娘！
examples.trans: Bake plenty of corner pieces, dear girl!

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè. Describes hot tea, hot water, or warm weather.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 这是现场啊。
examples.trans: This is site.

examples.text: 那个现场好。
examples.trans: That site is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú. Used for leaving a note/keepsake, saving food, or staying on (留下来).

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn qīng. Resultative verb compound 看 ('look/read') + 清 ('clear').

examples.text: 就算不戴老花镜，周经理站在两米外都能看清木牌上的大数字！
examples.trans: Even without wearing his reading glasses, Manager Zhou can read the big numbers on the wooden sign clearly from two metres away!

examples.text: 把走廊的灯打开吧，这样大家才能看清台阶。
examples.trans: Turn on the hallway light so everyone can see the steps clearly.

meanings.en: take a look; have a quick look
meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn kan. Friendly reduplicated form of 看.

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mī. Action verb for narrowing the eyes into a slit to read small print or smile warmly (眯着眼睛看 'squint to read').

examples.text: 小晴把价钱写得很大很清楚，谁都不用眯着眼睛费力去看。
examples.trans: Qing wrote the prices big and clear so nobody has to squint to read them.

examples.text: 院子里的老猫晒着太阳，舒服得眯起了眼睛。
examples.trans: Basking in the sun in the courtyard, the old cat narrowed its eyes contentedly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jing. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双眼睛 ('a pair of eyes').

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟爷爷的蛋糕味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!

related.gloss: a pair of eyes (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jìng. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副眼镜 ('a pair of glasses').

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

related.gloss: a pair of glasses (measure word 副)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. As a verb, 'stand' (站在旁边); as a noun, 'station/stop' (火车站).

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhú lán. Combines 竹 ('bamboo') + 篮 ('basket'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 宋老师问小晴有没有在门边留一个装共享图书的小竹篮。
examples.trans: Teacher Song asked Qing if she had left a small bamboo basket by the door for shared books.

examples.text: 小美提着一只干净的竹篮去集市挑选新鲜的黄柠檬和香草。
examples.trans: Mei carried a clean bamboo basket to the market to pick out fresh yellow lemons and herbs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn duǎn. Combines 简 ('simple/concise') + 短 ('short in length'), used for signs, messages, or speeches.

examples.text: 挂在街门上的欢迎木牌写得简短、温暖，又容易读。
examples.trans: The welcome sign hanging on the street gate is brief, warm, and easy to read.

examples.text: 小晴用简短清楚的几句话，把星期三的准备工作都记了下来。
examples.trans: In a few brief, clear sentences, Qing wrote down all the preparation tasks for Wednesday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǐ. As a measure word after numbers, means 'meter' (十米 'ten meters'); as a noun, 'uncooked rice'.

examples.text: 等等——现在十米外的院子里坐着谁？
examples.trans: Wait—who is sitting ten metres away in our courtyard right now?

examples.text: 五金店就在前面五十米的地方。
examples.trans: The hardware store is fifty meters ahead.

meanings.note: Verb liàn ('practise a skill').

examples.text: 要么你就好好练练你的厨艺。
examples.trans: Either you practise your cooking skills properly...

examples.text: 为了唱好高音，歌手每天在琴房练四个小时。
examples.trans: To nail the high notes, the singer practises four hours daily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì háo. Combines 自 ('self') + 豪 ('spirited/proud'): positive, heartfelt pride in good work or a team's achievement.

examples.text: 小美靠在厨房门口，自豪地看着两位徒弟端出热腾腾的面包和柠檬挞。
examples.trans: Leaning in the kitchen doorway, Mei watched proudly as her two apprentices brought out steaming bread and lemon tarts.

examples.text: 老陈提起这栋八十年历史的院子时，语气里总是充满了自豪。
examples.trans: Whenever Chen talks about this eighty-year-old courtyard, his voice is full of pride.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huā yuán. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个小花园 ('a small garden').

examples.text: 啊！看这儿：一楼，九号房，花园阳光房！
examples.trans: Aha! Look here: ground floor, Room Nine, garden sunroom!

examples.text: 等等，我们一楼有一个花园阳光房？
examples.trans: Wait, we have a garden sunroom on the ground floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá xù. Graceful compound 茶 ('tea') + 叙 ('chat warmly/converse'): an informal social gathering over tea.

examples.text: 木牌下面还有一行小字：星期五傍晚六点钢琴茶叙。
examples.trans: Underneath on the wooden sign is a line in smaller letters: Friday Piano Tea Social at Six O'Clock.

examples.text: 三十年前的每个星期五，九号房都会举办热闹的街坊音乐茶叙。
examples.trans: Every Friday thirty years ago, Room Nine hosted a lively neighbourhood music and tea social.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cài dān kǎ. Combines 菜单 ('menu') + 卡 ('card'); measure word: 张 (zhāng).

examples.text: 小晴写好了四张干净漂亮的菜单卡，准备放到每张木桌上。
examples.trans: Qing wrote out four clean, attractive menu cards to set on each of the wooden tables.

examples.text: 我把这些刚写好的菜单卡拿到厨房去，顺便看看小美。
examples.trans: I'll carry these freshly written menu cards into the kitchen and check on Mei while I'm at it.

营业.gloss: be open for business; operate commercially

meanings.en: be open for business; operate commercially
meanings.note: Pinyin: yíng yè. Verb-object compound 营 ('run/operate') + 业 ('business'); 每日营业 ('Open Daily') and 营业时间 ('business hours') are standard storefront terms.

examples.text: 九号房花园咖啡角每日营业，为街坊供应鲜汤、热面包和清茶。
examples.trans: Room Nine Garden Café Corner is open daily, serving fresh soup, warm bread, and fragrant tea to the neighbourhood.

examples.text: 街坊们看到门口挂出了营业木牌，都好奇地停下来看菜单。
examples.trans: Seeing the 'Open for Business' wooden sign hung at the gate, neighbours stopped curiously to read the menu.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng. Read xíng when meaning 'that works / okay' (不行 'won't work'); read háng when counting lines of text (第一行).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

meanings.en: neighbors; folks on the same street
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē fang. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位街坊 ('a neighborhood resident').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē mén. Combines 街 ('street') + 门 ('gate/door'): the outer gate opening from a courtyard house onto the lane; measure word: 扇 (shàn).

examples.text: 看看我们挂在街门上的小木牌——简短、温暖，又容易读。
examples.trans: Look at the small wooden sign we hung on the street gate—brief, warm, and easy to read.

examples.text: 星期三下午，小院的街门向整条梧桐巷的街坊敞开。
examples.trans: On Wednesday afternoon, the courtyard's street gate stood wide open to neighbours all along Wutong Lane.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guī dìng. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条规定 ('a regulation').

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

examples.text: 按照新规定，早晨八点起向邻居开放。
examples.trans: Under the new rule, we open to neighbors starting at eight a.m.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dú. Used for reading books, rules, or documents.

examples.text: 整份文件还没读完呢，周经理，别先认输。
examples.trans: We have not even finished reading the whole document, Manager Zhou—don't give up yet.

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dú shū jiǎo. Combines 读书 ('read books') + 角 ('corner/nook'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 对公众开放的咖啡角、街坊读书角，还有现场音乐——样样俱全！
examples.trans: A public café corner, a neighbourhood reading nook, and live music—every single piece is in place!

examples.text: 钢琴旁边的读书角摆着一篮干净的旅行书，谁都可以借阅。
examples.trans: Beside the piano, the reading corner has a basket of clean travel books that anyone is welcome to borrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí. Question pronoun for people; stays in the exact spot of the answer (这是谁的？ 'Whose is this?').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu láng. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条走廊 ('a hallway').

examples.text: 看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
examples.trans: Look at this arrow—it points at the bookcase in the hallway!

examples.text: 一扇真的门，就藏在走廊里！
examples.trans: A real door, hidden right here in the hallway!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chèn. Introduces a favorable moment before it passes (趁热吃 'eat while it's hot').

examples.text: 趁着阳光亮，我能再看看那张小纸牌吗？
examples.trans: While the sunlight is bright, may I look at that small paper tag again?

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.en: and also; in addition; still have
meanings.note: Pinyin: hái yǒu. Adds another item to a list ('plus…').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè xiē. Plural of 这个, needing no extra measure word before the noun.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

遍.gloss: time (once through, from start to finish)

meanings.en: time (once through, from start to finish)
meanings.note: Pinyin: biàn. Counts complete run-throughs of an action (再算一遍 'count it through once more'); compare 次 for simple occurrences.

examples.text: 等等……让我再算一遍。整个房间只要这么一点钱？
examples.trans: Wait... let me add it up again. The whole room needs only this much money?

examples.text: 请您再说一遍，好吗？
examples.trans: Could you say that once more, please?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà xiē. Plural of 那个 ('those').

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lín jū. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位邻居 ('a neighbor').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架钢琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇门 ('a door').

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 这是三楼阁楼门的小银钥匙。
examples.trans: Here is the small silver key to the third-floor attic door.

门边.gloss: beside the door; by the doorway

meanings.en: beside the door; by the doorway
meanings.note: Pinyin: mén biān. Place noun 门 ('door/gate') + 边 ('side/beside').

examples.text: 小晴在九号房的门边放了一个小竹篮，里面装着共享图书。
examples.trans: Beside the door of Room Nine, Qing placed a small bamboo basket filled with shared books.

examples.text: 雨伞架就放在走廊门边，客人们进出拿取都很方便。
examples.trans: The umbrella stand sits right beside the hallway door so guests can reach it easily coming and going.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bāo. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片面包 ('a slice of bread').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Smell that! Warm bread, hot scrambled eggs, and fresh herbs.

related.gloss: a slice of bread (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn yuè. Measure word (量词): 首 (shǒu), e.g. 一首音乐 ('a piece of music').

examples.text: 一点回声也没有！木头和玻璃让音乐更好听。
examples.trans: No echo at all! Wood and glass make music sound even better.

examples.text: 每个星期五六点！整条街的人都来这儿喝茶听音乐！
examples.trans: Every Friday at six! People from the whole street came here for tea and music!

related.gloss: a piece of music (measure word 首)

顺便.gloss: along the way; while at it; conveniently

meanings.en: along the way; while at it; conveniently
meanings.note: Pinyin: shùn biàn. Placed before a second action done conveniently on the same trip without an extra detour.

examples.text: 你去集市买柠檬的时候，顺便帮我买一卷黑胶带吧。
examples.trans: While you're at the market buying lemons, pick up a roll of black tape for me along the way.

examples.text: 我下楼拿快递，顺便把院子里的花浇了。
examples.trans: I went downstairs to pick up a parcel and watered the courtyard flowers while I was at it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Describes freshly picked/prepared ingredients (鲜汤 'fresh soup', 鲜花 'fresh flowers') and natural umami savouriness.

examples.text: 九号房花园咖啡角每日供应鲜汤、热面包、柠檬挞与清茶。
examples.trans: Room Nine Garden Café Corner serves fresh soup, warm bread, lemon tarts, and fragrant tea daily.

examples.text: 刚摘下来的百里香和欧芹煮进扁豆汤里，味道格外鲜美。
examples.trans: Freshly picked thyme and parsley simmered in the lentil soup give it a wonderfully bright, savoury flavour.
